headline: AI CapEx May Hurt Hyperscaler Margins and Credit — Here’s Why That Doesn’t Matter
summary: Investors are punishing hyperscalers for their massive AI spending sprees, but the real danger may lurk on the opposite side of the ledger. One company has found a way to sidestep the whole dilemma entirely, and it reveals something important about who actually wins this race.
